gocast.title: TUM.Live
gocast.description: Connect this Artemis course to a TUM.Live course.
gocast.refreshComplete: The TUM.Live connection is up to date.
gocast.error: TUM.Live could not complete the request. Try again.
gocast.restrictedWarning: This TUM.Live course has restricted visibility. The connection does not grant access to private videos, except the ones uploaded from Artemis.
gocast.disconnectQuestion: Disconnect this course and revoke Artemis access in TUM.Live?

tumLiveUpload.title: TUM.Live recording
tumLiveUpload.description: Upload the video to the connected TUM.Live course. Artemis shows it in this unit once TUM.Live has converted it. You can leave this page in the meantime.
tumLiveUpload.replaceDescription: This unit shows a video uploaded to TUM.Live. Upload another video to replace it; the old one is deleted in TUM.Live once the new one is ready.
tumLiveUpload.processing: TUM.Live is converting the video. Artemis attaches it to this unit when it is ready.
tumLiveUpload.attached: The video is ready and attached to this unit.
tumLiveUpload.transferFailed: The upload failed: {{ reason }}. Try again.
tumLiveUpload.unreachable: TUM.Live could not be reached, or the upload link has expired. Try again.
tumLiveUpload.lastError: The last upload was not attached: {{ reason }}
tumLiveUpload.deleteRecording: Also delete the video in TUM.Live
tumLiveUpload.deleteRecordings: Also delete the videos uploaded to TUM.Live for this lecture
